targets.title: A genome-wide association study reveals ARL15, a novel non-HLA susceptibility gene for rheumatoid arthritis in North Indians
targets.evidence_quote: Results from the present study are found to be analogous to the earlier study done on the north Indian population[ 13 ] and showed the statistical significance of  ARL15  polymorphism rs255758 with RA in the northwest Indian population ( P  = 0.024). reasoning: New case-control data retest the specific rs255758 RA association from Negi et al. 2013. Reference 15 concerns ARL15 protein levels, which this paper does not measure. The Han Chinese study (27) is a discussion comparison about population heterogeneity, rather than the Indian association explicitly selected for replication. Title and all seven authors match.
